newsitem.title: UK: Booker gains after press recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Booker gains after press recommendation.

text.p: Shares in foods group Booker Plc rose in early trade on Monday after positive comment on the stock in the Sunday Times.
Booker shares were up 14-1/2p or five percent at 300 by 0740 GMT in thin volume of just 42,307 shares.

The paper said Booker's chief executive Charles Bowen had pulled the company out of peripheral businesses while strengthening its core retail unit through the acquisition of wholesaler Nurdin & Peacock.
It said the stock could rise 50 percent without looking expensive on yield grounds.
